scenes.title: La répétition de François
scenes.summary: Veteran actor François Berléand rehearses Molière's Dom Juan in an avant-garde production set around a swimming pool, until young director Christophe Bel interrupts him from the water and insists he perform inside the pool with an inflatable yellow duck.
scenes.location: Theatre rehearsal hall with indoor swimming pool

scenes.title: Le canard en plastique
scenes.summary: François loses his temper over Christophe's pool staging and giant plastic duck, threatens to quit the play altogether, and makes Andréa promise to get the pool removed from the production.
scenes.location: Theatre rehearsal hall with indoor swimming pool

scenes.title: L'ultimatum de Catherine
scenes.summary: Mathias arrives at ASK to find his wife Catherine waiting in his office; furious over his lies about Camille, she orders him to fire his daughter immediately and walks out on him.
scenes.location: ASK entrance, staircase, and Mathias's office

scenes.title: Colette déménage chez Andréa
scenes.summary: After Andréa asks Camille to book dinner with Christophe Bel, tax inspector Colette Brancillon surprises Andréa by moving her audit files directly into Andréa's office so they can spend the workday together.
scenes.location: ASK open floor and Andréa's office

scenes.title: Le casting de Sofia
scenes.summary: Gabriel congratulates receptionist Sofia on landing a callback for Luc Besson's new film and coaches her to play the audition cool and natural, unaware of how much hope she is pinning on his encouragement.

scenes.title: Mathias renvoie Camille
scenes.summary: Cornered by Catherine's ultimatum, Mathias tells Camille that her hiring was a mistake, hands her a check with a recommendation to rival agent Dominique Besnehard, and coldly dismisses her from ASK.

scenes.title: Les soupçons d'Hervé
scenes.summary: Devastated by her father's dismissal, Camille hides her tears from Noémie while Hervé grows suspicious seeing Colette cozying up to Andréa inside her office.
scenes.location: ASK open floor and Andréa's office

scenes.title: Andréa rassure François
scenes.summary: Visiting François on a film shoot where he plays a general, Andréa promises to reason with Christophe Bel over dinner that evening so François will not have to set foot in the swimming pool.

scenes.title: Colette s'incruste au dîner
scenes.summary: Colette insists on accompanying Andréa to her working dinner with director Christophe Bel and asks to move into Andréa's apartment while her own flat is being repainted, leaving Andréa feeling suffocated.
scenes.location: Andréa's office and ASK open floor

scenes.title: La dispute d'Andréa et Gabriel
scenes.summary: Panicking over how fast Colette is moving, Andréa vents to Gabriel in the hallway; when Gabriel mocks her inability to commit, Andréa retaliates by questioning his suspicious closeness with receptionist Sofia.

scenes.title: Le départ de Catherine
scenes.summary: Mathias returns home expecting reconciliation after firing Camille, only to find Catherine packing her suitcases to leave him because she can no longer trust him after years of lies.

scenes.title: Un dîner sous tension
scenes.summary: At dinner with Christophe Bel, Colette's earnest psychoanalysis of Dom Juan's fear of commitment clashes with Andréa's efforts to get the stage pool removed, and Christophe storms out when he learns François refuses to get wet.

scenes.title: Le mensonge d'Andréa
scenes.summary: Chasing Christophe outside the restaurant, Andréa invents the excuse that François has severe chlorine allergy and eczema; afterwards, exasperated by Colette's interference, Andréa lies about having a trip to Berlin to avoid giving her spare apartment keys.

scenes.title: L'audition ratée de Sofia
scenes.summary: Following Gabriel's bad advice to act detached and casual, Sofia underplays her emotional scene at the callback; when casting director Constance tells Gabriel that Sofia lacked conviction and is cut, Gabriel cannot bring himself to tell Sofia the truth.

scenes.title: L'allergie au chlore
scenes.summary: At rehearsal the next day, Christophe announces he has drained the pool and bought a full-body wetsuit so François can perform despite his supposed eczema, humiliating François into walking out on both Christophe and Andréa.
scenes.location: Theatre rehearsal hall with indoor swimming pool

scenes.title: La vérité sur l'audition
scenes.summary: Pressured by Arlette to stop stringing Sofia along, Gabriel finally confesses to Sofia at reception that she did not get the role; heartbroken and furious that he lied to her, Sofia lashes out at him in front of the agency.
scenes.location: ASK open floor, Gabriel's office, and reception desk

scenes.title: Les adieux de Camille
scenes.summary: As Camille packs up her desk to leave ASK, Andréa urges her not to let Mathias push her out and admits how good an assistant she has been, before calling François to lure him to Christophe's party that night.

scenes.title: Un dernier verre au studio
scenes.summary: Heading out to Christophe Bel's party with François, Andréa calls Colette to promise she is only stopping for a quick drink in a simple outfit to save the play.

scenes.title: Le secret de François
scenes.summary: At the rehearsal studio party, François brings Christophe an inflatable duck as a peace offering but tries to leave when Christophe brushes him off; cornered by Andréa, François finally confesses his lifelong secret—he does not know how to swim.

scenes.title: Camille retrouve Mathias à l'hôtel
scenes.summary: Alone in a hotel room after Catherine leaves him, Mathias leaves a despairing voicemail on Catherine's phone just before hotel reception calls up to announce that Camille is waiting for him downstairs.

scenes.title: Le thé à l'anis étoilé
scenes.summary: Over dinner at Mathias's hotel, Camille shares how she fell in love with cinema at her uncle's video club, orders star-anise tea to soothe Mathias's upset stomach, and tells him she has not called Dominique Besnehard yet because Andréa wants her to stay.

scenes.title: Le traumatisme de la piscine
scenes.summary: Sitting by the pool with Christophe and Andréa, François recounts nearly drowning as a boy in Spain when a pool pump trapped his swimsuit; deeply moved, Christophe connects this fear of death to Dom Juan and pulls François into the shallow water in his arms.

scenes.title: La rupture avec Colette
scenes.summary: Celebrating François and Christophe's reconciliation, a drunken Andréa flirts with and kisses a woman at the party just as Colette arrives; heartbroken, Colette calls Andréa a heartless seducer and leaves in a taxi.
scenes.location: Rehearsal studio party and street outside

scenes.title: Le pardon de Sofia et la panique d'Andréa
scenes.summary: Gabriel visits Sofia at her apartment to apologize and shares a glass of port with her; back at his own flat, a soaked and drunken Andréa bursts in after falling into the pool and begs Gabriel to marry and save her.

scenes.title: La psychanalyse de Dom Juan
scenes.summary: Visiting the theatre to return Andréa's things, Colette delivers a brilliant analysis of Dom Juan's fear of monogamy and gifts Christophe her book on Donjuanism, inspiring his staging while turning down his request for her phone number.

scenes.title: Le retour de Madame Brancillon
scenes.summary: After three days without news from Colette, Andréa tries to focus on scripts until Colette returns to ASK cold and strictly professional, walking past Andréa into the conference room with the partners.

scenes.title: Le verdict du contrôle fiscal
scenes.summary: Addressing the ASK partners, Colette condemns their habit of charging personal hotel rooms, vacations, and even festival socks to company expenses, announcing a heavy fine and a summons to commercial court for misuse of corporate funds.

scenes.title: Menace de faillite chez ASK
scenes.summary: Panicked that the tax audit will scare off Mathias's father-in-law from buying Samuel's shares, the agents realize ASK faces bankruptcy and learn that Mathias and Catherine are separating just as Andréa storms out after Colette.
scenes.location: ASK conference room and open floor

scenes.title: Le baiser d'adieu
scenes.summary: Catching Colette on the street outside ASK, Andréa confesses her fear of commitment and begs Colette to teach her how to love; Colette kisses her in front of the stunned agency watching from above, then bids her a gentle farewell.
scenes.location: Street outside ASK and ASK balcony

scenes.title: Le whisky de Samuel et le cinéma
scenes.summary: That night, the four agents drink Samuel's whiskey together and tease a tipsy Mathias about his mysterious three-day disappearance at his first Cannes Festival; afterward, Arlette takes her dog Jean Gabin to a late-night movie with Hervé.
scenes.location: Samuel Kerr's office, ASK lobby, and Parisian cinema
